# HubSpot Field Notes

> Step-by-step HubSpot fixes, how-tos, and gotchas by Sam Barth, a HubSpot-certified practitioner. Each article lists the subscription tier and permissions required and the date the steps were last verified in a live HubSpot portal. Independent resource, not an official HubSpot publication.

- Link builder for direct links into any HubSpot portal: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/link-builder.html
- Request a fix: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/request-a-fix.html

## Content Hub

- ['This template doesn't allow modules to be added' in HubSpot: three causes](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/template-doesnt-allow-modules/): A blank HubSpot page that will not let you add modules usually has a template problem: an empty drag and drop area, a broken extends path, or overlapping columns. (Requires Any tier with website or landing pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Clone a HubSpot landing page for each location: what to change every time](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/clone-landing-page-per-location/): How to clone one good HubSpot landing page for each community or location, and the four settings plus content to change on every clone. (Requires Any tier with website or landing pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- ['You have reached your page limit' in HubSpot: look at your drafts](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/starter-page-limit/): HubSpot's Starter tier limits how many landing pages you can create. Untitled drafts show up in the same list as live pages, so check them first. (Requires Starter tier; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Speed up a HubSpot landing page: measure first, then fix images and page-level code](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/speed-up-landing-page/): How to find out why a HubSpot landing page is slow with Lighthouse, then fix the usual causes: heavy images, layout shift, and extra scripts in the page's Head and Footer HTML. (Requires Any tier with landing or website pages; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Your coded HubSpot template is missing from the template picker? Look under Other](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/coded-template-missing-from-picker/): The page template picker opens on your active theme. Templates that are not part of a theme only appear under Other. (Requires Any tier with pages; verified 2026-10-02)

## Data Hub

- [Why didn't this record enroll? Use HubSpot's Troubleshoot enrollment tool](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/troubleshoot-enrollment/): HubSpot workflows have a built-in tool that tests a specific record against the nine enrollment checks and tells you why it did or did not enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Enrich HubSpot companies from a spreadsheet when names don't match: import by Record ID](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/enrich-records-record-id-import/): When company names in a spreadsheet match more than one HubSpot company, export Record IDs, match your data to them, and import with Record ID as the identifier. (Requires Any tier (property creation needs property settings access); verified 2026-10-03)
- [Contact won't re-enroll in a HubSpot workflow? Check these 6 things](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/workflow-wont-re-enroll/): HubSpot enrolls a record once by default. Why re-enrollment fails, how to turn it on, and the triggers that can never re-enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-02)
- [HubSpot import created duplicate contacts? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicates-after-import/): HubSpot only matches imported rows by a unique identifier. Spot an import that duplicated records, clean it up, and stop it next time. (Requires Any tier (merging needs Professional); verified 2026-10-02)

## Marketing Hub

- [HubSpot says 180,000 contacts never opened your email? Check who was ever sent one](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/never-opened-email-stat/): A HubSpot segment of contacts who never opened an email also includes everyone who was never sent one. How to build the honest version before you sunset anyone. (Requires Marketing Hub Professional for the workflow; segments on paid tiers; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Build a speed-to-lead workflow in HubSpot with a follow-up SLA and escalation](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/speed-to-lead-sla-workflow/): A HubSpot workflow that creates a call task when a lead arrives, checks whether anyone made contact after a day, and escalates by email to the owner if nobody did. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Your HubSpot report shows zero SQLs? Set lifecycle stage from the deal, not the contact](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/sql-count-zero/): If reps work deals and never touch the contact's lifecycle stage, SQL reports stay at zero. A workflow can set associated contacts to Sales Qualified Lead when a deal reaches the right stage. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Why didn't this record enroll? Use HubSpot's Troubleshoot enrollment tool](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/troubleshoot-enrollment/): HubSpot workflows have a built-in tool that tests a specific record against the nine enrollment checks and tells you why it did or did not enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [How to opt a HubSpot contact out of all email (and why the API can't do it)](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/opt-out-contact-all-email/): Actions, Opt out of email stops future marketing and one-to-one email from HubSpot. Where it lives, what it does not stop, and why scripts and the API cannot set it. (Requires All tiers; verified 2026-10-03)
- [HubSpot 'Offline Sources' is not offline: how to see what created those contacts](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/offline-sources-explained/): Offline Sources in HubSpot means a record was created outside tracked web traffic, such as an import, the API, a connected app, or by hand. How to break it apart with the drill-down properties. (Requires All tiers for the properties; reports need Professional; verified 2026-10-03)
- [HubSpot campaign shows lots of influenced contacts but 0 sessions? You need tracking URLs](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/campaign-zero-sessions/): A HubSpot campaign full of assets can show hundreds of influenced contacts and zero sessions. Sessions only count when visits arrive through the campaign's tracking URL. (Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Which reports can HubSpot build? Report types, limits, and what needs a higher tier](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/which-reports-hubspot-can-build/): HubSpot's custom report types: single object, funnel, custom report builder, attribution, and email reports. What each can and cannot do, and which tier you need. (Requires Custom reports need Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-03)
- [Contact won't re-enroll in a HubSpot workflow? Check these 6 things](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/workflow-wont-re-enroll/): HubSpot enrolls a record once by default. Why re-enrollment fails, how to turn it on, and the triggers that can never re-enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-02)
- [HubSpot import created duplicate contacts? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicates-after-import/): HubSpot only matches imported rows by a unique identifier. Spot an import that duplicated records, clean it up, and stop it next time. (Requires Any tier (merging needs Professional); verified 2026-10-02)

Merge them, don't delete them](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/api-scripts-create-duplicates/): Why bulk writes through the HubSpot API create duplicate companies and contacts, how to merge instead of delete to keep associations, and how to write the script so it does not happen again. (Requires Any tier with a private app; verified 2026-10-03)
- [HubSpot 'Offline Sources' is not offline: how to see what created those contacts](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/offline-sources-explained/): Offline Sources in HubSpot means a record was created outside tracked web traffic, such as an import, the API, a connected app, or by hand. - [HubSQL beta: what it is, what it is not, and the 403 MISSING_SCOPES fix](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/hubsql-beta-api/): HubSpot's HubSQL beta lets you run SQL against CRM data over an API. What it can do, why it cannot connect to your SQL server, and how to fix a 403 for missing scopes. (Requires Private beta (invite only at the time of writing); verified 2026-10-03)

- [How to find your HubSpot portal ID (Hub ID)](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/find-hubspot-portal-id/): Your portal ID, also called Hub ID or account ID, is in the account menu and in every HubSpot URL. (Requires All tiers, including free; verified 2026-10-02)
